title: fix(plugin-grid,app-shell): the phone list scrolls its last card clear of the create button (objectui#13134)
body:
Fixes #13134

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

At 390x844 the object-list page's floating create button (`mobile-fab-create`: `fixed`, `bottom-36`, `h-12`) sits over the end of the list, and nothing can scroll the last card clear of it.

Measured before writing code (the PM's mechanism assumption 2, which box owns the scroll): **no box scrolls the phone card list at all.** Below 768px `ObjectGrid` draws stacked cards instead of the table, straight into `ListView`'s view area, which is `overflow-hidden`. So is every box between it and this page (the `ListView` root, `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` root and content). The table scrolls in its own body; the card list had no body of its own. So:

- a short list (the card's Projects, 5 records) fits, does not scroll, and its last card stays under the button;
- padding the list, the card's "Expected", cannot fix it alone: padding inside a clipping box grows the clipped box and makes no scroll room (measured below);
- a list taller than the screen is clipped, with nothing to scroll.

The clearance needs a scroller first. Assumption 1 holds for the button. Assumption 2 resolves to the card list's producer, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`'s card view (not `plugin-list`, not the console shell). Assumption 3 holds: the button renders on `showCreate`.

## The fix

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `ObjectGrid` card view:** the cards and the grid description scroll in a box of their own, `h-full overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden`, `data-testid="object-grid-card-scroller"`, marked `data-fab-clearance`. With no host padding it, it adds no room. Its host still bounds it, so `h-full` resolves. Under a host with no bounded height it grows with its content, as before.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `ObjectView`:** while the phone FAB is drawn, the list host carries `max-sm:[&_[data-fab-clearance]]:pb-48`, which is 12rem at the end of the marked scroller: the button's 9rem offset plus its 3rem height, so the last card scrolls above the button's top edge. `max-sm` is the button's own `sm:hidden`. The FAB and the room both read the existing `showCreate`, so they cannot disagree, and there is no room where the button is not drawn.

Nothing moves in any package entry: no export, prop or schema key. `data-fab-clearance` is a DOM attribute, the same posture as `data-fab-yield` (`ConsoleChatbotFab`).

## Geometry reading (replica in Chromium, not the live console)

The page is a replica built from the class strings of every box in the chain, read from this tree's source. That covers the layout `AppShell` with shadcn `SidebarProvider` and `SidebarInset`, the console `main`, `console-route`, `RouteFader`, this page's root, FAB and content chain, `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` root and content, the `ListView` root, toolbar, view area and record-count bar, and `ObjectGrid`'s card list and card class. Tailwind was compiled from the installed `tailwindcss` 4.3.3 for exactly those classes, and card contents are fixtures. Browser: Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, viewport 390x844. Input: 20 `mouse.wheel` steps (deltaY 400) over the list. Positions are px from the top.

| tree | cards | box that scrolls | last card before | last card after wheel | FAB top |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| base | 5 | none | 573 to 683 (under FAB) | 573 to 683 (under) | 652 |
| base | 20 | none (`ListView` view area clips 2368px into 718px) | 2343 to 2453 | unreachable | 652 |
| base, padding on the card list only | 5 | none | 573 to 683 | 573 to 683 (under) | 652 |
| this PR, FAB drawn | 5 | `object-grid-card-scroller` (padding-bottom 192px) | 573 to 683 | 501 to 611 (clear) | 652 |
| this PR, FAB drawn | 20 | `object-grid-card-scroller` | 2343 to 2453 | 501 to 611 (clear) | 652 |
| this PR, FAB not drawn | 5 | none (fits, padding-bottom 0) | 573 to 683 | 573 to 683 | none |
| this PR, FAB not drawn | 20 | `object-grid-card-scroller` (padding-bottom 0) | 2343 to 2453 | 693 to 803 (flush end) | none |

For the seat's live reading at 390x844 with real touch or wheel input: the scroll container is `[data-testid="object-grid-card-scroller"]`, the last card is `[data-testid="object-grid-card-scroller"] > .space-y-2 > :last-child`, and the button is `[data-testid="mobile-fab-create"]`.

## Tests

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cardScroller-13134.test.tsx`: at 390px every card sits inside exactly one `data-fab-clearance` box, which is the scroller (`h-full`, `overflow-y-auto`) and carries no padding of its own. At 1280px (the table) nothing carries the marker.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.mobileFabListClearance-13134.test.tsx`: with create offered (plain, and greyed by `disabledWhen`), an ancestor of the list's marked scroller pads it by at least the `bottom-N` plus `h-N` read off the FAB's own classes, under `max-sm`, matching the FAB's `sm:hidden`. With create hidden by `visibleWhen`, or closed by the principal, there is no button and no room.

Reverse verification. The fix was committed first (58c8790). Each mutation went through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor went from 1 hit to 0, the blob changed, and after the run the restored blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- app-shell leg, `listFabClearance` forced to `undefined`: predicted the two room cases RED and the two no-room cases GREEN. Observed `Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)`, both failures `expected null not to be null`.
- plugin-grid leg, the scroller's classes and marker removed: predicted the 390px case RED and the 1280px case GREEN. Observed `Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, failing with `expected  to have a length of 1 but got +0`.

## Gates (local, at HEAD 58c8790)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/ packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView` (through `os-verify-lock.sh`): `Test Files  305 passed (305)`, `Tests  2732 passed (2732)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` (`Tasks:    28 successful, 28 total`), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: both scripts echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, VERDICT command-exit 0. Each new test file is in its package's `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`, 1 hit each).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, "4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, "0 new citation(s)".
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0, OK.
- Not run locally (CI's): repo-wide lint and the full test farm. No i18n key or doc fence was touched.

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap: objectui#13150's in-flight branch also edits `ObjectGrid`'s card view (the `secondaryCols` line, a few lines below this PR's wrapper). The hunks are not adjacent. Whoever lands second merges `main`.
- Not measured and not changed here: the console's AI launcher (`ConsoleChatbotFab`, `fixed bottom-20 h-14` below `sm`) also floats over the list's bottom-right. While the create button is drawn this room clears it too, since it sits lower. Where create is not offered and the launcher is drawn, the list gets no room for it. Not reproduced in a browser. Carrier: none.
- Not measured and not changed here: other phone surfaces under the create button carry no `data-fab-clearance` box: the grouped grid (which keeps the table at phone width), kanban, gallery and calendar. Carrier: none.
- The FAB's comment says it sits above "the bottom mobile-nav (h-12 + safe-area)". The console draws no bottom nav (the button sits above the AI launcher). Left as is, outside this card.
